name: Manta SV Detection
overview: 基于 Illumina Manta 的结构变异检测流程，从配对末端（paired-end）测序数据中检测 DEL/DUP/INV/BND/INS 五类结构变异。利用丢弃读对（discordant read-pairs）和拆分读段（split-read）双重证据，对肿瘤-正常配对样本额外启用体细胞变异 calling，输出标准 VCF。
overviewEn: Illumina Manta structural variant detection pipeline, calling DEL/DUP/INV/BND/INS from paired-end sequencing data using discordant read-pairs and split-read evidence. Supports somatic calling for tumor-normal pairs.

references.title: Manta: rapid detection of structural variants and indels for germline and cancer sequencing applications (Chen et al., 2016)

steps.name: 安装与配置
steps.description: 源码编译安装 Manta，配置运行环境和参考基因组
steps.descriptionEn: Build Manta from source and configure reference genome

tools.name: cmake + make
tools.notes: 需要 Python 2.7/3.x 和 C++11 编译器。

steps.notes: Bioconda 安装：conda install -c bioconda manta。

steps.name: 生成配置文件
steps.description: 使用 configManta.py 生成运行配置，指定 BAM 和参考基因组
steps.descriptionEn: Generate workflow config with configManta.py, specifying BAM(s) and reference

tools.name: configManta.py
tools.notes: 肿瘤-正常配对：--tumorBam tumor.bam --normalBam normal.bam。

steps.notes: 配置文件生成在指定 runDir 中，无需手动编辑。
steps.notesEn: Config files generated in designated runDir, no manual editing required.

steps.name: 运行 SV 检测
steps.description: 执行 Manta 工作流，基于配对末端和拆分读段证据检测结构变异
steps.descriptionEn: Execute Manta workflow to detect SVs using paired-end and split-read evidence

tools.name: runWorkflow.py
tools.notes: -m local 本地运行；-m sge 集群模式；-j 并行任务数。
tools.notesEn: -m local for single node; -m sge for SGE cluster; -j parallel jobs.

steps.notes: 输出 diploidSV.vcf.gz（种系）和 somaticSV.vcf.gz（体细胞，仅肿瘤-正常模式）。
steps.notesEn: Outputs diploidSV.vcf.gz (germline) and somaticSV.vcf.gz (somatic, tumor-normal only).

steps.name: 结果过滤
steps.description: 按质量过滤 VCF：FILTER=PASS、QUAL>20、去除低置信度变异
steps.descriptionEn: Filter VCF by quality: FILTER=PASS, QUAL>20, remove low-confidence calls

tools.name: bcftools view
tools.notes: 或使用 GATK VariantFiltration 自定义过滤参数。
tools.notesEn: Or use GATK VariantFiltration for custom filters.

steps.notes: Manta 内置 FILTER 字段标记（PASS/HighDepth/LowQual 等），过滤后可衔接 AnnotSV 注释。
steps.notesEn: Manta's built-in FILTER field marks (PASS/HighDepth/LowQual), filtered output feeds into AnnotSV.
